LIST.DESCRIPTION: Build custom forms to collect information on tickets - link one to a Service Catalog item to attach it automatically to the checklist, or to a Help Center article.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete form
DELETE.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete the form

BUILDER.DESCRIPTION: Build the questions, link it to the Service Catalog or to an Article, and publish when ready.
BUILDER.NO_FIELDS: No questions yet - pick a type below to add one.
BUILDER.RESPONSES_NEEDS_SAVE: Save the form to see its responses.
BUILDER.LINKED_CATALOG_NONE: Not linked to any catalog item yet.
BUILDER.LINKED_CATALOG_HINT: The link is set on the Service Catalog screen, when editing the item.
BUILDER.ACCESS_TITLE: Who can fill it in the Help Center
BUILDER.ACCESS_LOGIN_HINT: The customer signs in with the Customer Area login; anyone not signed in goes to the login and comes back to the form.
BUILDER.ACCESS_OPEN_HINT: Anyone with the link can fill it. There is a send limit per IP and the answers are kept without a ticket.
BUILDER.SUCCESS_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g.: Received! We will reply within 1 business day.
BUILDER.LINKS_NEED_PUBLISH: Publish the form to generate the links. Linked to an article, it shows up on its own in the Help Center.

FILL.SUCCESS_DEFAULT: Thank you! Your answers were recorded.
FILL.NOT_FOUND_TEXT: This form does not exist, is not published or the link is wrong.
FILL.TOO_MANY: Too many submissions. Wait a few minutes and try again.
